api_version: Atlantic HURDAT2 1851-2025, 2026-September historical 1971-1975 reanalysis revision; exact original filename and content hash to be pinned

request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation-only, no automatic source request or caller-selected path, unbounded domain, secrets, crawler, bulk extraction or retries. Metadata path(s) are only candidate exact origins; actual provider GET requires independently reviewed provider machine-use terms, exact URL, byte cap, body hash and source-specific approved workflow.

response_contract.format: Official NHC public archive index, not the ~6.8-MB original comma-delimited tropical-cyclone best-track file. No windfield/return-level source bytes included.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Best-track approximately six-hour storm centers, maximum sustained winds, central pressure, wind radii from 2004. Not an original European extratropical windfield or insurer loss. NHC/HURDAT2 and NOAA IBTrACS may share NHC original tracks; cross-database agreement not independent and events must not be doubled.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: No live archive sweep or file download under this documentation-only contract; review fixed original text path, caching, contact and one-shot request budget before parser.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: NHC periodically issues HURDAT2 revisions; pin exact filename, modification date, SHA and reanalysis window before comparing with IBTrACS.

rights_and_policy.notes: NHC's official archival description is public but exact original file's redistribution/third-party lineage and service automation terms have not been independently reviewed; no blanket public-domain or insurer CAT model entitlement inferred.

notes: Original September 2026 archive revision is confirmed on publisher page, but 6.8-MB original text file URL, byte SHA, header parser, historical revisions and independent windfield challenge are not yet fixed. No provider asset download/Neon write/model admission.
